name: wayfinder/search_api_wayfinder
description: Search API backend plugin targeting the Wayfinder Solr-wire-compatible server.

autoload-dev._comment: Drupal\search_api\ below is a test-harness-only shim, not a runtime dependency declaration. search_api ships no composer autoload of its own (Drupal core's module classloader resolves it at runtime instead), so this unit-test sandbox needs Composer to find it at its vendor/ path. A real site running composer/installers relocates it to web/modules/contrib/..., where this hardcoded vendor/ path would not resolve -- hence autoload-dev, not autoload. Guzzle is a genuine runtime dependency (via Drupal core's http_client service) so it does not need a shim; it resolves normally through vendor/.
